topStories.headline: Jackson Hole Countdown: Warsh's First Fed Chair Keynote Arrives as September Hike Odds Sit at 37%
topStories.summary: The Kansas City Fed's annual symposium (Aug 27-29) draws intense scrutiny as new Chair Kevin Warsh — who succeeded Jerome Powell in May 2026 — delivers his debut keynote Friday, just three weeks before the September FOMC meeting.
topStories.marketImpact: Rates watch: hawkish lean → bonds ↓ yields ↑ USD ↑ equities ↓; dovish tone → SPY QQQ ↑ TLT ↑; current fed funds rate held at 3.50–3.75% in July (9-3 vote)

topStories.headline: Nvidia Reports Q2 FY27 Earnings Wednesday — $93-95B Revenue Forecast in AI Bellwether Test
topStories.summary: Wall Street expects Nvidia to post ~$93-95 billion in revenue (+67% YoY) driven by Data Center AI-GPU demand, in results that will set the tone for the entire AI infrastructure trade ahead of Jackson Hole.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↑ on beat with broad AI-chip complex (AMD, SMCI) likely following; miss or soft guidance risks tech-led selloff into a critical macro week

topStories.headline: S&P 500 Snaps Three-Week Win Streak; Nasdaq Off 2% as July Payrolls Disappoint and Bond Yields Rebound
topStories.summary: US equities fell last week — S&P 500 -1.4% to 7,674, Nasdaq -2%, Dow -0.9% — after July nonfarm payrolls came in at -23,000 vs. the +83,000 consensus, though Friday's strong PMI data sparked a partial recovery.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY QQQ under pressure ↓; 10Y yield ~4.70%, 30Y ~5.25%; July PCE due Wednesday is the key inflation test — softer energy prices may ease the print

topStories.headline: Tencent Q2: Revenue Up 11% but AI Capex Surges 176% to RMB 52.8B, Turning Free Cash Flow Negative
topStories.summary: Tencent posted solid Q2 results (revenue RMB 204.8B, adjusted net profit +9%) but a 176% YoY jump in capex to RMB 52.8 billion on AI infrastructure investment pushed free cash flow to negative RMB 13.8 billion.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK near-term FCF pressure ↓; management framing AI spend as future revenue driver; Hang Seng Tech index broader read-through

topStories.headline: Japan CPI Hits 1.9% — Highest This Year — as Energy Costs Rise, Cementing BOJ September Hike Case
topStories.summary: Japan's headline inflation accelerated to 1.9% in July from 1.6% in June — a second consecutive monthly increase — driven by rising energy costs tied to Middle East tensions, with analysts now calling a BOJ rate hike from 1% to 1.25% in September near-certain.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑ on hike pricing; JGB yields ↑; Japanese financials ↑; Toyota and export-heavy stocks ↓ on stronger yen headwind

topStories.headline: Japan Q2 GDP Misses Estimates at 1.1% Annualized as Weak Domestic Demand Offsets Export Strength
topStories.summary: Japan's economy grew just 0.3% QoQ (1.1% annualized) in Q2, below the 0.5% QoQ consensus, with exports adding 0.5pp but weak household consumption dragging the headline lower — adding stagflation risk to the BOJ's policy calculus.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei 225 ↓ near 66,016; BOJ faces uncomfortable mix of above-target inflation and sub-par growth; watch domestic consumer stocks

topStories.headline: South Korea KOSPI Slips Below 7,000 as Rising US Bond Yields and Iran Tensions Weigh on Chipmakers
topStories.summary: The KOSPI retreated into the 6,800-point range as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix — together more than 50% of the index — fell sharply amid rising US and Japanese Treasury yields and renewed Middle East uncertainty dampening risk appetite.
topStories.marketImpact: 005930.KS 000660.KS ↓; KOSPI still up ~41% YTD in USD terms; Nvidia earnings Wednesday a pivotal signal for Korean chipmaker momentum

topStories.headline: Oil Retreats to Pre-War Levels Near $72-73/Bbl as Middle East Supply Fears Ease; Gold Holds Above $4,500
topStories.summary: Brent crude has pulled back to ~$72-73/barrel as rising Middle East supply expectations outweigh geopolitical risk, while gold remains elevated above $4,500/oz — on course for a third straight weekly gain — as investors seek safe-haven assets amid bond market volatility.
topStories.marketImpact: XLE ↓ on oil retreat; GLD ↑ (gold miners rally); softer energy prices may ease July PCE inflation reading due Wednesday
